title: wielblad.mp3 by miastodzwiekow
author: miastodzwiekow
sourceDescription: 25.04.2010: about 15.00. Sunday. on the Dolna Wilda Street in the Jan Pawel II Park (in the center of the city of Poznan in Poland). Recording made on the park meadow where was the travelling circus Arena located. the circus has a lot of animal, among others two camels. I recorded the reaction of some child on one of these camels. The camel was standing near of the street that is why the typical traffic noises are so audible. The boy said: "hello Mr Camel! How are you?" The boy's mother was taking photos. There was a crowd around that camel.
